setup_per_run: fresh container (fresh home folder), fresh SolidCraft 0.26.1 window with a new design, fresh Claude Code 2.1.311 session (claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5, default mode), the plug added with solidcraft-cli mcp setup and wrapped in the logging proxy, no CLAUDE.md, auto memory off

scoring.names_used: count of user parameters in parameters.list after the run, and which of the 7 sketch dimensions and the extrude distance have an expression that references a user parameter
scoring.edit_followed: the 8 sketch corners at (0,0) (40,0) (40,10) (35,10) (35,5) (5,5) (5,60) (0,60) within 0.01 mm in the sketch plane (either orientation reported), Z from 0 to 60, volume 10000 +-0.1 mm3, bounding box 40 x 20 x 60
scoring.edit_by_parameter: the calls sent after message 2 change hook_depth (set_parameter or parameters.change) and move no sketch point
scoring.reading_of_40_deep: recorded: outside depth 40 (box 40) or arm 40 (box 45) or other; a different reading is reported as such, not as a failure of names
